storyCards.headline: Goodbye Yellow Brick Road: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Elton John's "Goodbye Yellow Brick Road" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Goodbye Yellow Brick Road was released in 2007.

"Goodbye Yellow Brick Road" by Elton John.

Chart story — peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
